headline: ANGLOGOLD ASHANTI BETS $72.7M ON SITKA GOLD — Producer Takes 15% Stake in TSX-V Yukon Explorer as Majors Hunt Undervalued Juniors
snippet: AngloGold Ashanti has announced a $72.7 million strategic investment to acquire a 15% stake in Sitka Gold (TSX-V: SIG), one of the largest producer-to-junior investments of 2026 — coming precisely when junior gold equities are trading at multi-year discounts. The deal gives AngloGold a foothold in Sitka's RC Gold project in the Yukon, a district being targeted by multiple major gold companies. It signals that producer investment below the newsworthy acquisition threshold is accelerating as buyers seek exposure to quality exploration assets without paying full acquisition premiums in the current correction.

headline: ONTARIO GREENLIGHTS SPRINGPOLE — First Mining Gold Clears Provincial EA, Unlocks Path to 2028 Construction Decision on Major Deposit
snippet: First Mining Gold (TSX: FF) has secured Provincial Environmental Assessment approval from Ontario for its Springpole Gold Project — a critical regulatory milestone that unlocks the path to a federal EA, feasibility study completion, and a targeted construction decision in 2028. Springpole, located in northwestern Ontario, is one of Canada's largest undeveloped open-pit gold deposits. The approval arrives during the deepest gold equity correction of 2026, potentially increasing First Mining's strategic value as a permitting-de-risked development asset at a time when acquisitive gold majors are hunting for ready-to-build projects at distressed valuations.

headline: USA RARE EARTH DUMPS 7%, MP MATERIALS -3% — Sector Extends Selloff Ahead of Trump-Xi Meeting on Critical Minerals
snippet: USA Rare Earth fell 7% while MP Materials shed 3% and Critical Metals declined 5% as the rare earth equities complex extended its volatile November selloff ahead of an anticipated Trump-Xi bilateral on critical minerals policy. Traders appear to be reducing exposure ahead of a geopolitical event that could either unlock new supply-chain agreements or harden US-China tensions further — particularly around China's ongoing licensing regime on medium and heavy rare earth exports. The move adds to a year-to-date decline of over 40% for US-listed rare earth equities despite rising physical prices in China.

headline: NVIDIA WITHOUT HUANG: AI DEAL PAUSE PUTS COPPER DEMAND TIMELINE AT RISK — Oilprice.com Examines What Months of Uncertainty Mean for Miners
snippet: With Nvidia's share price down 30% since Jensen Huang's resignation and AI datacenter deal pipelines cooling, OilPrice.com examines the structural risk to copper demand from an AI-investment pause. Data centres are copper-intensive, and a prolonged uncertainty at Nvidia could defer significant tonnage. Goldman Sachs calls the move a positioning correction, not a fundamental break; Panmure Liberum counters that 'every time AI takes a hit, copper comes under pressure too.' The analysis notes that Chinese physical buyers paying record import premiums suggests the selloff is financial, not demand-driven — but that the demand timing risk is real.

headline: GOLDSEEK NOV 23: GOLD AND SILVER FIND FOOTING IN ASIA — Physical Buyers Re-Enter at 14-Month Lows as Forced Selling Fades
snippet: GoldSeek's Asian metals market update for November 23 reports gold and silver finding early footing as physical buyers re-entered precious metals markets following the worst weekly selloff of 2026. With US Thanksgiving-week liquidity thin through Friday, Asian session price movements are carrying more market-making weight than usual. The piece notes the tension between technical oversold signals and physical buying at the low end against lingering pressure from the dollar at 19-month highs and near-certainty pricing for a December Federal Reserve rate hike.

headline: TRISTAR GOLD MAPS NEXT PHASE AT CASTELO DE SONHOS — TSX-V Brazilian Gold Project Outlines Post-Correction Exploration Priorities
snippet: TriStar Gold (TSX-V: TSG) outlined its next exploration and development steps at the Castelo de Sonhos gold project in Pará, Brazil — one of the larger undeveloped gold resources in the Amazon region. The announcement is notable for coming amid the junior financing freeze: management is mapping a prioritized work program designed to advance the project through the current market downturn without relying on equity markets that have largely shut for early-stage companies. The Castelo de Sonhos district has long-term strategic appeal given Brazil's lower political risk profile compared to other South American gold jurisdictions.

headline: MILLENNIUM SILVER BUILDS NEVADA DRILL PADS — Silver Peak Site Ready for First Holes After Drone Mag and Water Infrastructure Complete
snippet: Millennium Silver (TSX-V: MSC) has completed drone magnetic surveying, water infrastructure installation, and drill pad construction at its Silver Peak silver-gold project in Esmeralda County, Nevada — moving the project to drill-ready status. Nevada's Esmeralda Basin is a proven silver-producing district, and completing pre-drill infrastructure during the current financing freeze positions MSC to initiate drilling once conditions improve or the company closes a drill funding round. The drone mag results will be used to refine target selection before the first holes turn.

headline: THACKER PASS LITHIUM BUDGET BLOWS OUT BY $900M — Lithium Americas CEO Warns Tariffs and Labour Are Wrecking US Critical Minerals Economics
snippet: Lithium Americas' flagship Thacker Pass mine in Nevada has seen its construction budget balloon nearly $900 million over original estimates, driven by labour shortages, rising wages, and tariff-driven materials cost increases. The CEO's public warning that similar US-based critical minerals projects will face identical headwinds is a direct challenge to the administration's domestic battery supply chain strategy — raising hard questions about whether taxpayer-subsidized lithium projects can be built economically under current input cost conditions. For junior mining investors, the message is stark: development-stage lithium projects carry a material cost-escalation risk that pre-feasibility estimates rarely capture.

headline: GOLDSEEK Q3'26: GOLD MID-TIERS POST RECORD CASH FLOWS — But All-In Costs at All-Time High Compress the Margins Investors Expected
snippet: GoldSeek's quarterly fundamentals review of gold mid-tier producers for Q3 2026 shows the sector generating its strongest-ever aggregate cash flows — but all-in sustaining costs also hit new records, narrowing the margins that high gold prices were supposed to deliver. The analysis identifies why mid-tier gold equities are trading at multi-year discounts despite financial strength: cost inflation is structurally compressing per-ounce economics. With gold now correcting to the $3,500-$3,650 range, the review flags which mid-tiers are closest to margin squeeze risk and which carry the buffer to weather a prolonged correction.

headline: GOLDSEEK COT NOV 20: GOLD SPECULATIVE LONGS NEAR MULTI-YEAR LOW — Historically a Contrarian Buy Signal as Weak Hands Exit
snippet: GoldSeek's November 20 Commitment of Traders analysis shows managed money net long positions in gold futures falling sharply as speculative accounts exit following the 9% weekly decline — a positioning dynamic that has historically preceded sharp recoveries once forced selling exhausts itself. The COT data provides retail investors with context for evaluating entry timing: extreme bearish positioning is a classic contrarian indicator, though the US dollar index sitting near 19-month highs remains the principal macro headwind for a sustainable reversal. Silver's COT positioning showed even more extreme capitulation, consistent with its 15% weekly decline.
